fact: The SudaPass terms of use (published 2026-05-21; the date is used as the as_of since the terms carry no other date) treat the Electronic Transactions Act of 2007 and its amendments as the governing law, stating that a digital signature meeting its requirements is equivalent to a handwritten signature (Article 8) and that forgery is punishable under Article 28.
The analyst lists the 2007 Electronic Transactions Act among Sudan's existing sector laws, saying it regulates the electronic signature.
